themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents and their application in research tasks, encompassing automation, orchestration, and agentic workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code, including code generation and vulnerability detection.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to analyze customer data, identify trends, and automate engagement for businesses.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI's role in the creative process of design and research, including AI-generated design and research platform functionalities.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's ability to analyze user sentiment from feedback, reviews, and social media.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Content that uses AI to condense and extract key insights from large volumes of text, such as research findings or user feedback.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discussions about platforms that leverage AI to facilitate or enhance research processes, including data analysis and tool integration.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles exploring the creation and use of artificial user data or personas for AI training, testing, or privacy-preserving research.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in understanding market needs, validating product ideas, and guiding product development.

themes.name: AI UX tools
themes.description: Content related to AI-powered tools specifically designed to enhance the user experience design and research process.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
